issues.description: Close message string mismatches PR's stated CloseStream contract.
issues.detail: PR description and Deepgram docs say the control message is {"type": "CloseStream"}, but the code sends {"type": "Close"}. The data here is a tiny JSON envelope — get the shape right or the server won't recognize it and the fix won't fix the bug. Verify against Deepgram's Speak socket spec.

issues.description: Single receive() with 1s timeout is a guess, not a drain.
issues.detail: One receive() call consumes at most one frame; Deepgram may send several before closing. Either loop until CLOSED/timeout, or just close. As written it's neither a real drain nor a clean no-op — pick a data shape (loop with deadline) that makes the algorithm obvious.

issues.description: Broad except Exception swallows cancellation and programming errors.
issues.detail: Wrapping the close sequence in bare except Exception will catch real bugs and log them as warnings. Narrow to ConnectionResetError / aiohttp errors, or let asyncio.CancelledError propagate. Small composable error handling beats a catch-all swallow.

issues.description: Constants defined as class attributes when module-level would be simpler.
issues.detail: _FLUSH_MSG and _CLOSE_MSG are immutable strings unrelated to instance state. Module-level constants would be more honest about the data — they're not part of SynthesizeStream's structure, just literals the close path needs. Minor, but it's the kind of small clarity Pike's rules push toward.

review.summary: The fix is the right shape — send a control message, give the server a moment, then close — but the data is wrong: the payload is {"type": "Close"} while the PR (and Deepgram's API) say {"type": "CloseStream"}. That mismatch likely defeats the fix entirely and should be verified against the Speak socket spec before merge. Secondary nits: the single receive() with 1s timeout isn't really a drain, the bare except Exception is too wide, and the message constants belong at module scope. Overall small and composable — just verify the wire format.
